text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that focuses on estimating greenhouse gas emissions from land use change due to oil palm expansion in Pará, Brazil—a subnational (state-level) region—not at the national scale. Although it uses land use change projections under three enforcement scenarios, its primary objective is not LULC prediction but rather carbon emission estimation. Furthermore, it fails the core inclusion criterion of "explicit national-scale spatial implementation," as the study area is limited to the state of Pará. It also lacks quantitative accuracy metrics for the LULC modeling and does not validate or report predictive performance of the land use allocation model (UPLAN). Thus, it meets exclusion criteria due to regional-scale focus and absence of national-scale LULC prediction.)
